close_reason: Fixed: Email 14 comment now says '100-byte body, mid-range size' instead of 'smallest'
description: Email 14 comment introduced in f11d14b says 'smallest of three sort-test emails' but Email 14 body is 100 bytes while Email 16 is 50 bytes — the comment is factually wrong on introduction. A contributor reading the comment to understand sort ordering will be misled about which email represents the size floor.
title: seed.rs: Email 14 comment says 'smallest' but is wrong
